# Model Routing Dashboard Configuration v1.0
# Grafana-style dashboard for AI model routing and performance monitoring

dashboard:
  version: "1.0"
  title: "Agentic Workflow - Model Routing"
  description: "AI model routing decisions, performance, and optimization insights"
  
  # Dashboard metadata
  metadata:
    tags: ["agentic", "model-routing", "ai", "performance"]
    refresh_interval: "30s"
    time_range: "last_1h"
    
  # Dashboard panels
  panels:
    # Model Overview
    - title: "Active Models"
      type: "stat"
      grid_pos: {"x": 0, "y": 0, "w": 8, "h": 8}
      targets:
        - expr: "count(count by (model) (model_requests_total))"
          legend_format: "Active Models"
      field_config:
        defaults:
          unit: "short"
          thresholds:
            steps:
              - color: "green"
                value: 0
              - color: "yellow"
                value: 3
              - color: "red"
                value: 5
